messages:
Maya (People Ops): @channel Heads-up: Eng Summit (onsite) Sept 15-17 in Boulder. We're finalizing travel and family-care support. Please read and pick options in the quick form: https://tinyurl.com/eng-summit-options

Rohan (Eng Events): Tentative agenda: 15: arrival + welcome mixer, 16: full-day sessions + breakout labs, 17: morning show-and-tell + optional local hikes. We'll publish session sign-ups next week.

Danielle (Travel Ops): Travel stipend: $350 round-trip domestic, $700 international (one-time). If you prefer to fly earlier or stay later, submit full itinerary and we'll reimburse actuals up to the stipend. Hotel: we've blocked rooms at The Ridge (code: REDWOOD23). Booking deadline Aug 25.

Priya: Is there any childcare support? I have a 6yo and need help while sessions run.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — two options: 1) Onsite child care during session hours (limited slots; ages 2-12) — free. 2) Family-care stipend: up to $400 per family for caregivers, eldercare, or local daycare. Select on the form and add notes about ages/needs.

Olivia (People Ops): Childcare sign-ups open Aug 1. We partner with LittleNest — background-checked providers, snacks, nap areas. If you need allergen accommodations, note it.

Sam (Facilities): Accessibility: hotel ADA rooms are in the block. We'll have one quiet room for pumping/parenting and a baby-changing station in the main lounge. If you need fridge/med storage, let me know.

Rohan (Eng Events): Roommate matching: If you'd like to share a room to reduce costs, toggle "roommate match" on the form and we'll match by preferences (non-smoker, quiet, same gender preference optional). Only do this if you're comfortable.

Danielle (Travel Ops): Shuttle from Denver Int'l (DEN) to Boulder will run Sept 15 (07:30, 11:00, 15:00) and return Sept 17 (14:00, 18:00). If you plan to drive and need parking, select "parking" on the form; we'll validate which lots are available.

Priya: If I book earlier flights because daycare availability is limited, will the stipend cover extra nights?

Danielle (Travel Ops): Booked lodging within policy window (Sept 14-18) will be covered up to the stipend. For exceptions, attach receipts and tag "eng-summit-exception" and we'll review.

Maya (People Ops): Important HR notes: 1) If you're bringing a guest (family) to the welcome mixer, add their name in the form for guest badges. 2) If you need to take unpaid time for family care during the summit, coordinate with your manager. 3) Code of conduct applies — respectful behavior expected.

Childcare-Bot: child-care-bot created booking form: "Eng Summit Childcare" (opens Aug 1).

Olivia (People Ops): Emergency contacts: we'll collect local emergency contact for each attendee (private to HR). If you have medical accommodations, DM me directly.

Rohan (Eng Events): Quick ask to managers — please post team expectations for summit deliverables and on-call coverage by Aug 10 so we can finalize session rosters.

Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: Fill options form (travel, childcare, roommate, shuttle) by Aug 10. Hotel booking by Aug 25. Questions here or DM. We're trying to make this family-friendly and low-friction ":heart:"

calendar-bot: calendar event created "Eng Summit — Boulder" Sep 15 09:00 to Sep 17 13:00 (labels: all-hands, people-ops).
